top_news.title: Pesticides: Farmers, Victims and Health and Environmental Organizations Call on MPs to Remove Section 13 of Bill C-31
top_news.summary: OTTAWA, Ontario/TRADITIONAL AND UNCEDED TERRITORY OF THE ALGONQUIN ANISHINAABEG PEOPLE, Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- At a press conference in Ottawa today, a coalition of farmers, people who have become ill, and health and environmental organizations called on the government and all Members of Parliament to remove Section 13 of Bill C-31. This measure, which has been criticized by the Senate and is currently before the House of Commons Standing Committee on Finance, was inserted into a budget bill. It would eliminate the requirement to reassess registered pesticides every 15 years. The coalition stresses the urgent need to strengthen, not weaken, pesticide oversight in Canada.
